Esperanto

[edit]
Esperanto Wikipedia has an article on:
organismo
Wikipedia eo

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /orɡaˈnismo/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ismo
  • Syllabification: or‧ga‧nis‧mo

Noun

[edit]

organismo (accusative singular organismon, plural organismoj, accusative plural organismojn)

  1. (biology) organism
    Hyponyms: animalo, besto, planto

Derived terms

[edit]
  • organisma

Further reading

[edit]
  • “organismo”, in Plena Ilustrita Vortaro de Esperanto [Complete Illustrated Dictionary of Esperanto], 2020, →ISBN
  • “organismo”, in Reta Vortaro [Online Dictionary] (in Esperanto), 1997-2026

Galician

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

organismo m (plural organismos)

  1. organism

Ido

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Esperanto organismo, English organism, French organisme, German Organismus, Italian organismo, Russian органи́зм (organízm), Spanish organismo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /or.ɡaˈnis.mo/

Noun

[edit]

organismo (plural organismi)

  1. (biology) organism

Interlingua

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

organismo (plural organismos)

  1. organism

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /or.ɡaˈniz.mo/
  • Rhymes: -izmo
  • Hyphenation: or‧ga‧nì‧smo

Noun

[edit]

organismo m (plural organismi)

  1. organism
  2. body, system (human body)
  3. (figurative) organization, body, authority, structure, agency

Synonyms

[edit]
  • ente (3)
  • corpo (1,3)
  • organizzazione (3)
  • struttura (3)

Related terms

[edit]
  • organismo geneticamente modificato
  • organo

Anagrams

[edit]
  • orangismo, marginoso, orgasmino

Portuguese

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /oʁ.ɡaˈniz.mu/ [oɦ.ɡaˈniz.mu]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /oʁ.ɡaˈniz.mu/ [oɦ.ɡaˈniz.mu]

organismo m (plural organismos)

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English organism.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /oɾɡaˈnismo/ [oɾ.ɣ̞aˈniz.mo]
  • Audio (Venezuela):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ismo
  • Syllabification: or‧ga‧nis‧mo

Noun

[edit]

organismo m (plural organismos)

  1. organism, creature
  2. human body
  3. organization, committee, body
  4. corporate body

Related terms

[edit]
  • organizar
  • órgano

References

[edit]
  1. ^ “organismo”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

[edit]

organismo (Baybayin spelling ᜂᜇ᜔ᜄᜈᜒᜐ᜔ᜋᜓ)
